summary: Tested the 3 improvements to the 'Il Mio Avatar' box using user_avatar_test (FAMILY) and sub-profile fam_avatar_kid 'Giulia'. 1) Photo check (Home /dashboard, getUserMedia mocked to reject so the fallback native input is used): dark.jpg -> 'Foto troppo buia'; nofeet.jpg -> 'Non vediamo i piedi'; nohead.jpg -> 'Foto tagliata in alto' (cut_top: a different but valid code, accepted per the note). In every case the red panel showed with 'La foto non è stata salvata', no body form appeared, and GET /api/profile/avatar kept path null. avatar-retake-btn closes the panel and reopens the camera. fullbody.jpg gave no issue, then the body form, then a save (avatar-ready, path vfit/avatar/user_avatar_test/...). 2) Family: switched to Giulia with the FamilySwitcher (sets localStorage and reloads). Title shows 'Il Mio Avatar · Giulia', empty state, the dark photo was rejected, fullbody plus 150/45 saved to vfit/avatar/fam_avatar_kid/... with profile_name 'Giulia'. The main avatar path did not change. Measurements are separate (Giulia 150cm/chest 67, main 175cm/chest 81). The avatar persists after reload (img naturalWidth 800). Switching back to the owner clears localStorage and shows the plain title. 3) Reminder: with avatar_at set to 70 days ago, avatar-refresh-reminder shows 'Sono passati più di 2 mesi ... del 09/08/2026', and avatar-refresh-btn opens the camera. With a date 10 days ago it is hidden. It is not shown on /settings (manage mode), as designed. Backend: new tests/test_avatar_family.py (11 tests) plus the existing test_avatar.py: 25 passed, 1 skipped (run serially with -n 0, because both files use the same user). Test data cleaned at the end: avatars, measurements and weight_history removed for both profiles.

minor.issue: An unknown or foreign X-Profile-Id silently falls back to the owner account instead of returning 403/404. There is no data leak, but a stale localStorage atelier_active_profile (e.g. a deleted sub-profile) would make the UI save avatar/measurements on the OWNER while the user thinks they are on the child profile. The FamilySwitcher shows the owner name in that case, so the risk is low.

issues: The language selector 'IT' pill overlaps the 'HOME' nav link: the text renders garbled ('HO✕ME') in some screenshots. Pre-existing, not part of this task.
The greeting still says 'Ciao di nuovo, Test.' (owner name) while the Giulia profile is active. Consider showing the profile name, as the avatar title does.

action_items: Optional: reject an invalid X-Profile-Id (403), or clear the stale active profile on the frontend, to avoid writing to the owner by mistake
Optional: fix the header language pill overlapping the HOME link
Optional: show the active family profile name in the Home greeting
critical_code_review_comments: pose.js: the cut_top/cut_bottom checks run before too_far and use tight thresholds (top <= 0.5% of H, bottom >= H-2). A head cut at the frame edge is classified cut_top rather than no_head when the nose landmark is still visible. This is acceptable.

pose.js: the brightness threshold (mean luma < 55) is global. A well-lit person against a very dark background could be wrongly rejected as too_dark. Consider measuring luma on the segmentation mask area.

AvatarBox: if the MediaPipe model or WASM fails to load (network), the error message is not a known code and falls back to 'Non vediamo bene la tua figura'. A dedicated network-error message would be clearer.
AvatarProvider refetches only on user change. Profile switches rely on window.location.reload() in FamilySwitcher, which works, but the provider is not reactive to profile changes.
seed_data_creation: None created. Avatars and measurements created during the tests were removed for user_avatar_test and fam_avatar_kid (users.avatar_path/avatar_at unset, measurements and weight_history deleted).
